2611.34563.title: On Utilization of Edge-AI for condition monitoring towards predictive maintenance: A use case in dairy processing using explainable AI
2611.34563.paper_summary: The Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are driving Industry 4.0, enhancing productivity, automation, and efficiency in manufacturing systems. This study develops an Edge-AI-based condition monitoring framework, as a step towards predictive maintenance, for a rotary valve in a dairy processing pilot plant, using vibration data collected via a low-power IIoT sensor node and processed on an edge device.
2611.34563.author: Rahul Umesh Mhapsekar et.al.
2611.34563.authors: Rahul Umesh Mhapsekar, Norah O'Shea, Omer Ali, Steven Davy, Lizy Abraham
